name: GHW International
summary: GHW International, an investment holding company, manufactures and sells chemical and pharmaceutical products in the People's Republic of China, Europe, Vietnam, the rest of Asia, and internationally. It operates through seven segments: Methylamine Industry Series; Goldenhighway New Materials; Advanced Materials Intermediates Series; Green Products; Healthcare and Wellness; Iodine Derivatives and Supporting Products; and Happy Elephant Selections. The Methylamine Industry Series segment consists of animal nutrition chemical products, such as choline chloride and betaine.
